g.text: Test A. Points are scene clusters; lines connect scene medians. No k is selected from this plot.
Four historically exposed scene clusters: 2001, 2003, 2014, 2009. Known background χ₀ = 0.1 + 0.04i; fixed 32D material chart.
All plotted errors and energy fractions are in-chart. FULL-J is an OFFLINE diagnostic only; no formal validation is implied.
A1/A2/A3 select the same direction sets in this screening; coincident markers are retained.
